newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE August white sugar freight differentials.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE August white sugar freight differentials.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) issued new freight differentials for its white sugar contract to cover the August delivery period.

The exchange notice showed the following premiums -- Penang, Port Kelang, Singapore $2 (unchanged from May), Inchon $8 (unchanged), Ulsan $6 (unchanged), Bangkok/Kohsichang, Laemchabang $3 (unchanged), Sriracha $3 (zero), Guangzhou, Huangpu, Shekou and Xiamen all $5 (unchanged), Recife and Maceio $8 ($6), Santos $16 ($13), Imbituba/Itajai and Buenos Aires $14 ($11), New Orleans and Savannah $13 ($12), Matanzas $17 ($16) and Durban $4 (unchanged).
